title: Inception says Mercury 3 generates over 1,000 tokens a second
script:
Inception just launched Mercury 3, an AI model that hits a massive speed milestone.
It generates over one thousand tokens every single second.
That kind of velocity completely changes how real time applications handle data.
Faster outputs mean your software can talk back instantly without lag.
Would you switch to an application running on Mercury 3?
